orders_in_progress_requires_processing_a.name: orders_in_progress_requires_processing_at
orders_in_progress_requires_processing_a.value: "orders"."status" NOT IN ('processing', 'confirmed', 'failed') OR "orders"."processing_at" IS NOT NULL

orders_terminal_timestamps_after_queued_.name: orders_terminal_timestamps_after_queued_at
orders_terminal_timestamps_after_queued_.value: ("orders"."confirmed_at" IS NULL OR "orders"."confirmed_at" >= "orders"."queued_at") AND ("orders"."failed_at" IS NULL OR "orders"."failed_at" >= "orders"."queued_at")
